explanation: This lemma says that the unit map `eta` composed with `lift` gives back the original morphism. Its content comes from the library's own definitions of the maximal pro-p quotient (`eta` and `lift`, built on `isoLimittoFiniteQuotientFunctor`). I searched all of Mathlib for `IsProP`, `MaximalProP` and `proPCompletion`, with no matches. Mathlib does not seem to have pro-p groups or a maximal pro-p quotient construction. The proof uses only general category-theory glue (`cancel_iso_hom_right`, `Category.assoc`, `Iso.inv_hom_id`) and `rfl`, and these do not count as a match.
